source.text: Τότε ὁμοιωθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν δέκα παρθένοις, αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου.

records.literal_gloss: Then will be likened the kingdom of the heavens to ten virgins, who having taken the lamps of them went forth to meeting of the bridegroom.

en.L: Then the kingdom of the heavens will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
en.B: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten young women who were bridesmaids. They took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
en.R: When that day comes, the kingdom of heaven will be like this. Ten young women were bridesmaids at a wedding. They took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

es.L: Entonces será comparado el reino de los cielos a diez vírgenes, las cuales, habiendo tomado sus lámparas, salieron al encuentro del novio.
es.B: En aquel tiempo, el reino de los cielos será como diez muchachas que eran damas de honor en una boda. Tomaron sus lámparas y salieron a recibir al novio.
es.R: Cuando llegue ese día, el reino de los cielos será así: diez muchachas eran damas de honor en una boda. Tomaron sus lámparas y salieron a recibir al novio.

fr.L: Alors le royaume des cieux sera semblable à dix vierges qui, ayant pris leurs lampes, sont sorties à la rencontre de l’époux.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, il en sera du royaume des cieux comme de dix jeunes filles, demoiselles d’honneur à un mariage. Elles ont pris leurs lampes et sont sorties à la rencontre du marié.
fr.R: Quand ce jour viendra, le royaume des cieux sera comme ceci. Dix jeunes filles étaient demoiselles d’honneur à un mariage. Elles ont pris leurs lampes et elles sont sorties pour aller à la rencontre du marié.

sw.L: Wakati huo ufalme wa mbinguni utafananishwa na mabikira kumi, ambao walichukua taa zao wakatoka kwenda kumpokea bwana harusi.
sw.B: Wakati huo ufalme wa mbinguni utakuwa kama wasichana kumi waliokuwa wapambe katika harusi. Walichukua taa zao, wakatoka kwenda kumpokea bwana harusi.
sw.R: Siku hiyo itakapofika, ufalme wa mbinguni utakuwa hivi: wasichana kumi walikuwa wapambe katika harusi. Walichukua taa zao, wakatoka kwenda kumpokea bwana harusi.

vi.L: Bấy giờ vương quốc thiên đàng sẽ giống như mười trinh nữ cầm đèn mình đi ra đón chàng rể.
vi.B: Lúc ấy, vương quốc thiên đàng sẽ giống như mười cô gái làm phù dâu. Họ cầm đèn đi ra đón chàng rể.
vi.R: Khi ngày ấy đến, vương quốc thiên đàng sẽ giống như thế này. Có mười cô gái làm phù dâu trong một đám cưới. Họ cầm đèn đi ra đón chàng rể.

ko.L: 그때에 천국은 자기 등불을 들고 신랑을 맞으러 나간 열 처녀에게 비유될 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에 천국은 신부의 들러리를 선 열 처녀와 같을 것이다. 그들은 저마다 등불을 들고 신랑을 맞으러 나갔다.
ko.R: 그날이 오면 천국은 이런 이야기와 같을 것이다. 열 명의 젊은 여자가 결혼식에서 신부의 들러리를 서게 되었다. 그들은 저마다 등불을 들고 신랑을 맞으러 나갔다.

pt.L: Então o Reino dos céus será semelhante a dez virgens que, tomando as suas lâmpadas, saíram ao encontro do noivo.
pt.B: Naquele tempo, o Reino dos céus será como dez moças que eram damas de honra. Elas pegaram as suas lamparinas e saíram ao encontro do noivo.
pt.R: Quando aquele dia chegar, o Reino dos céus será assim: dez moças eram damas de honra num casamento. Elas pegaram as suas lamparinas e saíram para encontrar o noivo.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መብራቶቻቸውን ይዘው ሙሽራውን ለመቀበል የወጡትን አሥር ደናግል ትመስላለች።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ መንግሥተ ሰማያት በሰርግ ላይ ሚዜዎች የነበሩ አሥር ልጃገረዶችን ትመስላለች። እነርሱም መብራቶቻቸውን ይዘው ሙሽራውን ለመቀበል ወጡ።
am.R: ያ ቀን ሲመጣ የሰማይ መንግሥት እንዲህ ትሆናለች። አሥር ልጃገረዶች በአንድ ሰርግ ላይ ሚዜዎች ነበሩ። መብራቶቻቸውን ይዘው ሙሽራውን ለመቀበል ወጡ።

decisions.choice: then: when the Son of Man comes, as in 24:44-51
decisions.reason: The parable continues the teaching about the Son of Man's coming that began at 24:4. "Then" points to that day.

decisions.choice: virgins: unmarried young women, here serving as bridesmaids
alternatives: a statement about their moral life
decisions.reason: The word names young women of marrying age who were not yet married. The story is about their part in the wedding, not their purity.

decisions.choice: going out to meet the bridegroom: a wedding custom
alternatives: meeting him at the bride's home only
decisions.reason: A bridegroom went to fetch his bride and brought her to his home, often in the evening. Friends of the couple met the procession with lamps and went in with them to the feast.

decisions.choice: to meet the bridegroom, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: to meet the bridegroom and the bride, the reading of some manuscripts and early translations
decisions.reason: Some Greek and Latin and Syriac witnesses add "and the bride". Most manuscripts end with the bridegroom alone, and the story speaks only of him. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: young women who were bridesmaids
decisions.reason: "Virgins" draws attention to something the story is not about. Balanced and Readable say who they were and what they were doing; Literal keeps the word.

decisions.choice: When that day comes
decisions.reason: Readable says what "then" refers to, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase, kept at every level through the book; Spanish says "los cielos" in the plural naturally, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: the parable of 25:1-12 in the passé composé and the imperfect at every level; the present "viennent" of 25:11 kept at Literal
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The parable is Jesus speaking, and the style guide keeps the tenses of speech for a story told inside a speech, as in Mark 4 and Luke 19:12-27.

decisions.choice: dix vierges (L); dix jeunes filles, demoiselles d’honneur (B, R); l’époux (L), le marié (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable say who they were (m2). "Demoiselles d’honneur" is the French word for bridesmaids. "L’époux" (L) and "le marié" (B, R) as in Mark 2:19 and Luke 5:34; the bridegroom is a figure in the parable and takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni
decisions.reason: Matthew's own phrase, kept at every level through the book.

decisions.choice: mabikira (L); wasichana ... wapambe (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is unmarried young women (meaning decision m2). Literal says "mabikira"; Balanced and Readable say what they were doing, as the English does: "wapambe" are the young attendants at a Swahili wedding. "Wanawali" is the older word and is little used today.

decisions.choice: "mười trinh nữ" (L); "mười cô gái làm phù dâu" (B, R)
alternatives: "mười cô trinh nữ" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word is an unmarried young woman, here serving as a bridesmaid (meaning decision); Literal keeps the word, Balanced and Readable say what they were doing, as the English does. They are "các cô" through the parable.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc thiên đàng"
decisions.reason: As settled for Matthew: one phrase for the kingdom of the heavens at every level.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 25:1-13; "천국" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (style guide, section 7). "천국" is settled for the Korean Matthew (7:21). The bridegroom is a figure in the story and takes no honorific.

decisions.choice: "처녀" (L, B); "젊은 여자" (R); "신부의 들러리" added (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word means unmarried young women, here bridesmaids (meaning decision); "처녀" says both. Balanced and Readable say what they were doing, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "비유될 것이다" (L); "같을 것이다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 18:23 and 22:2, Literal keeps the passive "will be compared".

decisions.choice: moças que eram damas de honra
decisions.reason: As the English: Balanced and Readable say who the women were and what they did. "Moça" is the ordinary Brazilian word for an unmarried young woman; "damas de honra" names their part in the wedding. Literal keeps "virgens".

decisions.choice: lâmpadas (L); lamparinas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is not the "candeia" of 5:15 but the lamp or torch carried in a procession (meaning decision on 25:3). Literal keeps "lâmpadas", the old word for it; Balanced and Readable say "lamparinas", oil lamps a Brazilian reader can picture, since "lâmpada" today is an electric bulb.

decisions.choice: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" (L, B); "የሰማይ መንግሥት" (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew's "kingdom of the heavens". Literal and Balanced keep the church's living name for it, "መንግሥተ ሰማያት"; Readable says the same thing in plain Amharic, "the kingdom of heaven". The noun is treated as feminine ("ትመስላለች"), as in the church usage.

decisions.choice: "ደናግል" (virgins, L); "ልጃገረዶች" (young women, B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek word's sense with "ደናግል". Balanced and Readable say "young women" and, as the English does, name their role at the wedding with "ሚዜዎች", the attendants every Ethiopian wedding has.

source.text: πέντε δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι.

records.literal_gloss: Five now of them were foolish and five wise.

en.L: Now five of them were foolish, and five [were] wise.
en.B: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
en.R: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

es.L: Y cinco de ellas eran necias, y cinco [eran] prudentes.
es.B: Cinco de ellas eran necias, y cinco eran prudentes.
es.R: Cinco de ellas eran tontas, y cinco eran sabias.

fr.L: Or cinq d’entre elles étaient insensées, et cinq [étaient] avisées.
fr.B: Cinq d’entre elles étaient insensées, et cinq étaient sages.
fr.R: Cinq d’entre elles étaient étourdies, et cinq étaient sages.

sw.L: Basi watano miongoni mwao walikuwa wajinga, na watano [walikuwa] wenye busara.
sw.B: Watano kati yao walikuwa wajinga, na watano walikuwa na busara.
sw.R: Watano kati yao walikuwa wajinga, na watano walikuwa na akili.

vi.L: Trong số đó, năm cô dại dột và năm cô khôn ngoan.
vi.B: Năm cô trong số đó dại dột, còn năm cô khôn ngoan.
vi.R: Năm cô dại dột, còn năm cô khôn ngoan.

ko.L: 그런데 그들 가운데 다섯은 어리석었고, 다섯은 슬기로웠다.
ko.B: 그 가운데 다섯은 어리석었고, 다섯은 슬기로웠다.
ko.R: 그 가운데 다섯 명은 어리석었고, 다섯 명은 슬기로웠다.

pt.L: E cinco delas eram tolas, e cinco [eram] prudentes.
pt.B: Cinco delas eram tolas, e cinco eram prudentes.
pt.R: Cinco delas eram tolas, e cinco eram sábias.

am.L: ከእነርሱም አምስቱ ሞኞች፣ አምስቱም ብልሆች ነበሩ።
am.B: ከእነርሱ አምስቱ ሞኞች፣ አምስቱ ደግሞ ብልሆች ነበሩ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ አምስቱ ሞኞች ነበሩ፤ አምስቱ ደግሞ ብልሆች ነበሩ።

decisions.choice: foolish, wise: lacking or showing good sense about what is coming
decisions.reason: The same pair describes the two builders in 7:24-27. Wisdom here is being ready; folly is not thinking ahead.

decisions.choice: necias, prudentes (L, B); tontas, sabias (R)
decisions.reason: "Prudente" is the word used for the wise servant in 24:45, as the Greek uses the same word there (meaning decision m1). Readable uses everyday words.

decisions.choice: insensées (L, B), étourdies (R); avisées (L), sages (B, R)
decisions.reason: The traditional French "vierges folles" now sounds like "mad"; the Greek word means lacking good sense (m1), which "insensées" says, and Readable uses the everyday "étourdies". Literal keeps "avisé" for the other word, as in 24:45.

decisions.choice: wajinga (foolish); wenye busara (wise)
decisions.reason: The point is lack of good sense about what is coming (meaning decision m1); "wapumbavu" is a harsh insult in everyday Swahili. "Busara" is the word used for the wise servant in 24:45, as the Greek uses the same word there.

decisions.choice: "dại dột" and "khôn ngoan"
decisions.reason: "Khôn ngoan" is the word for the wise servant in 24:45, so the two parables are heard together, as the Greek uses one word for both.

decisions.choice: "어리석은", "슬기로운" for moros and phronimos, through the parable
decisions.reason: "슬기롭다" is practical good sense about what is coming (meaning decision); "어리석은" is the word of the Korean Matthew 7:26.

decisions.choice: tolas, prudentes (L, B); tolas, sábias (R)
decisions.reason: "Prudente" is the Portuguese word for the good sense of thinking ahead that the meaning decision describes; "tola" is its plain opposite. Readable says "sábias", as the English "wise". "Loucas" would suggest madness.

decisions.choice: "ሞኞች" (foolish) and "ብልሆች" (wise)
decisions.reason: The older pair "ሰነፍ" / "ልባም" is familiar from church reading, but in today's Amharic "ሰነፍ" means "lazy": it would blur this parable with the next, where the slave is called lazy (25:26, "ሰነፍ"). "ሞኝ" and "ብልህ" are the everyday words for lacking and having good sense.

source.text: αἱ γὰρ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔλαβον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἔλαιον·

records.literal_gloss: The for foolish having taken the lamps of them not did take with themselves oil;

en.L: For the foolish, taking their lamps, did not take oil with them;
en.B: The foolish ones took their lamps but brought no oil along with them.
en.R: The foolish bridesmaids took their lamps, but they did not take any extra oil with them.

es.L: Porque las necias, tomando sus lámparas, no tomaron consigo aceite;
es.B: Las necias tomaron sus lámparas, pero no llevaron aceite consigo.
es.R: Las muchachas tontas tomaron sus lámparas, pero no llevaron aceite de repuesto.

fr.L: Car les insensées, en prenant leurs lampes, n’ont pas pris d’huile avec elles ;
fr.B: Les insensées ont pris leurs lampes, mais elles n’ont pas emporté d’huile avec elles.
fr.R: Les jeunes filles étourdies ont pris leurs lampes, mais elles n’ont pas pris d’huile en plus.

sw.L: Kwa maana wale wajinga, walipochukua taa zao, hawakuchukua mafuta pamoja nao;
sw.B: Wale wajinga walichukua taa zao, lakini hawakuchukua mafuta yoyote pamoja nao.
sw.R: Wale wasichana wajinga walichukua taa zao, lakini hawakuchukua mafuta ya akiba.

vi.L: Vì các cô dại dột cầm đèn mình nhưng không đem dầu theo;
vi.B: Các cô dại dột cầm đèn theo nhưng không mang thêm dầu.
vi.R: Các cô dại dột cầm đèn đi, nhưng không mang theo dầu dự trữ.

ko.L: 어리석은 처녀들은 자기 등불을 가지고 가면서도 기름은 함께 가져가지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 어리석은 처녀들은 등불은 가지고 갔지만 기름은 따로 챙기지 않았다.
ko.R: 어리석은 여자들은 등불은 가지고 갔지만, 남는 기름은 가지고 가지 않았다.

pt.L: Pois as tolas, tomando as suas lâmpadas, não levaram azeite consigo;
pt.B: As tolas pegaram as suas lamparinas, mas não levaram azeite com elas.
pt.R: As moças tolas pegaram as suas lamparinas, mas não levaram azeite de reserva.

am.L: ሞኞቹ መብራቶቻቸውን ሲይዙ ከራሳቸው ጋር ዘይት አልያዙምና፤
am.B: ሞኞቹ መብራቶቻቸውን ያዙ፤ ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ ጋር ዘይት አልወሰዱም።
am.R: ሞኞቹ ልጃገረዶች መብራቶቻቸውን ያዙ፤ ነገር ግን ተጨማሪ ዘይት ከእነርሱ ጋር አልወሰዱም።

decisions.choice: lamps: torches or small oil lamps carried at night
decisions.reason: The word can mean a torch, a pole wrapped with rags soaked in oil, or a lamp. Either way it needed a fresh supply of oil to keep burning. The story does not settle which is meant.

decisions.choice: no oil with them: no supply beyond what was in the lamps
decisions.reason: Their lamps were burning but going out by 25:8, so the lack is a spare supply.

decisions.choice: extra oil
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the lamps had some oil, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "đèn"
decisions.reason: The Greek word can be a torch or a small oil lamp (footnoted meaning decision); "đèn" fits a light that burns oil and leaves the footnote to give the other picture.

decisions.choice: "등불" for lampas, every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word can mean a torch or an oil lamp (meaning decision, footnoted); "등불" covers a carried light of either kind, as in the Korean Matthew 5:15.

decisions.choice: azeite
decisions.reason: For the whole passage. The lamps burned olive oil, which Portuguese calls "azeite"; "óleo" would suggest cooking or engine oil.

source.text: αἱ δὲ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ τῶν λαμπάδων ἑαυτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: The but wise took oil in the vessels with the lamps of them.

en.L: But the wise took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
en.B: But the wise ones took flasks of oil as well as their lamps.
en.R: But the wise ones took jars of oil with them, as well as their lamps.

es.L: Pero las prudentes tomaron aceite en las vasijas junto con sus lámparas.
es.B: Pero las prudentes llevaron frascos de aceite además de sus lámparas.
es.R: Pero las sabias llevaron con ellas jarras de aceite, además de sus lámparas.

fr.L: mais les avisées ont pris de l’huile dans des flacons avec leurs lampes.
fr.B: Les sages, elles, ont pris des flacons d’huile en plus de leurs lampes.
fr.R: Mais les jeunes filles sages ont emporté des pots remplis d’huile, en plus de leurs lampes.

sw.L: Lakini wale wenye busara walichukua mafuta ndani ya chupa pamoja na taa zao.
sw.B: Lakini wale wenye busara walibeba chupa za mafuta pamoja na taa zao.
sw.R: Lakini wale wenye akili walibeba mitungi ya mafuta, pamoja na taa zao.

vi.L: Nhưng các cô khôn ngoan đem dầu trong bình cùng với đèn mình.
vi.B: Còn các cô khôn ngoan thì mang theo bình dầu cùng với đèn.
vi.R: Nhưng các cô khôn ngoan mang theo những bình dầu, cùng với đèn của mình.

ko.L: 그러나 슬기로운 처녀들은 자기 등불과 함께 그릇에 기름을 가져갔다.
ko.B: 그러나 슬기로운 처녀들은 등불과 함께 기름을 그릇에 담아 가져갔다.
ko.R: 그러나 슬기로운 여자들은 등불과 함께 기름을 병에 담아 가져갔다.

pt.L: Mas as prudentes levaram azeite nos frascos junto com as suas lâmpadas.
pt.B: Mas as prudentes levaram frascos de azeite além das suas lamparinas.
pt.R: Mas as moças sábias levaram vasilhas com azeite, além das lamparinas.

am.L: ብልሆቹ ግን ከመብራቶቻቸው ጋር በዕቃዎች ዘይት ያዙ።
am.B: ብልሆቹ ግን ከመብራቶቻቸው ጋር በብልቃጦች ዘይት ያዙ።
am.R: ብልሆቹ ግን ከመብራቶቻቸው በተጨማሪ በማሰሮ ዘይት ይዘው ሄዱ።

decisions.choice: vessels: small containers for carrying oil
decisions.reason: The word is a general one for a container. It is separate from the lamps.

source.text: χρονίζοντος δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου ἐνύσταξαν πᾶσαι καὶ ἐκάθευδον.

records.literal_gloss: Tarrying then the bridegroom they became drowsy all and were sleeping.

en.L: And while the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and were sleeping.
en.B: When the bridegroom was late in coming, every one of them nodded off and slept.
en.R: The bridegroom was late. All the young women got sleepy and fell asleep.

es.L: Y tardando el novio, cabecearon todas y dormían.
es.B: Como el novio tardaba en llegar, a todas les entró sueño y se durmieron.
es.R: El novio tardó mucho. A todas las muchachas les dio sueño y se quedaron dormidas.

fr.L: Et comme l’époux tardait, elles se sont toutes assoupies, et elles dormaient.
fr.B: Comme le marié tardait à venir, elles se sont toutes assoupies et se sont endormies.
fr.R: Le marié était en retard. Toutes les jeunes filles ont eu sommeil, et elles se sont endormies.

sw.L: Na bwana harusi alipokuwa akichelewa, wote walilemewa na usingizi, nao walikuwa wamelala.
sw.B: Bwana harusi alipochelewa kufika, wote walianza kusinzia, wakalala usingizi.
sw.R: Bwana harusi alichelewa. Wasichana wote walishikwa na usingizi, wakalala.

vi.L: Và vì chàng rể đến chậm, tất cả đều buồn ngủ và ngủ thiếp đi.
vi.B: Vì chàng rể đến trễ, cả mười cô đều thiu thiu rồi ngủ thiếp đi.
vi.R: Chàng rể đến trễ. Tất cả các cô đều buồn ngủ và ngủ thiếp đi.

ko.L: 그런데 신랑이 늦어지자, 그들은 모두 졸다가 잠이 들었다.
ko.B: 신랑이 늦어지자, 처녀들은 모두 졸다가 잠이 들었다.
ko.R: 신랑은 늦게 왔다. 여자들은 모두 졸리기 시작하더니 잠이 들었다.

pt.L: E, demorando o noivo, todas cochilaram e dormiam.
pt.B: Como o noivo demorou a chegar, todas elas cochilaram e adormeceram.
pt.R: O noivo demorou. Todas as moças ficaram com sono e dormiram.

am.L: ሙሽራው በዘገየ ጊዜም ሁሉም አንቀላፉ፤ ተኝተውም ነበር።
am.B: ሙሽራው መምጣቱን ባዘገየ ጊዜ ሁሉም እንቅልፍ ይዟቸው ተኙ።
am.R: ሙሽራው ዘገየ። ልጃገረዶቹ ሁሉ እንቅልፍ ወሰዳቸውና ተኙ።

decisions.choice: tarrying: delayed, slow to come
decisions.reason: The same verb describes the slave's thought "my master is delayed" in 24:48. The delay is part of the lesson about watching.

decisions.choice: all slept: the wise as well as the foolish
decisions.reason: Sleep is not the fault. The difference between them is the oil they brought.

source.text: μέσης δὲ νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν· Ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος, ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: At middle then of night a cry there was: Behold the bridegroom, go forth to meeting of him.

en.L: And at midnight there was a cry, 'Look, the bridegroom! Go out to meet him.'
en.B: In the middle of the night a shout was heard: 'The bridegroom is here! Go out to meet him.'
en.R: At midnight someone shouted, 'The bridegroom is here! Go out and meet him!'

es.L: Y a medianoche hubo un grito: “¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, el novio! {{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} a su encuentro”.
es.B: A medianoche se oyó un grito: “¡Ya está aquí el novio! {{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} a recibirlo”.
es.R: A medianoche alguien gritó: “¡Ya llega el novio! ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} a recibirlo!”.

fr.L: Et au milieu de la nuit, il y a eu un cri : “Voici l’époux ! Sortez à sa rencontre.”
fr.B: Au milieu de la nuit, on a entendu crier : “Le marié est là ! Sortez à sa rencontre.”
fr.R: À minuit, quelqu’un a crié : “Le marié arrive ! Sortez pour aller l’accueillir !”

sw.L: Basi katikati ya usiku kulitokea kelele: 'Tazama, bwana harusi! Tokeni nje mkampokee.'
sw.B: Usiku wa manane kelele zilisikika: 'Bwana harusi yuko hapa! Tokeni nje mkampokee.'
sw.R: Usiku wa manane mtu mmoja alipiga kelele, 'Bwana harusi yuko hapa! Tokeni nje mkampokee!'

vi.L: Đến nửa đêm, có tiếng kêu lên: 'Kìa, chàng rể! Hãy ra đón chàng.'
vi.B: Nửa đêm, có tiếng gọi lớn: 'Chàng rể đến rồi! Hãy ra đón chàng!'
vi.R: Đến nửa đêm, có người la lên: 'Chàng rể đến rồi! Hãy ra đón chàng!'

ko.L: 그런데 한밤중에 외치는 소리가 났다. '보라, 신랑이다! 그를 맞으러 나오너라.'
ko.B: 한밤중에 외치는 소리가 들렸다. '신랑이 왔다! 나가서 맞이하여라.'
ko.R: 한밤중에 누군가 소리쳤다. '신랑이 왔다! 어서 나가서 맞이하여라!'

pt.L: E, à meia-noite, houve um grito: 'Vejam, o noivo! Saiam ao encontro dele.'
pt.B: No meio da noite, ouviu-se um grito: 'O noivo está chegando! Saiam ao encontro dele.'
pt.R: À meia-noite, alguém gritou: 'O noivo está chegando! Saiam para encontrá-lo!'

am.L: በእኩለ ሌሊትም ጩኸት ሆነ፦ “እነሆ፣ ሙሽራው! ልትቀበሉት ውጡ።”
am.B: በእኩለ ሌሊትም “ሙሽራው ደርሷል! ልትቀበሉት ውጡ።” የሚል ጩኸት ተሰማ።
am.R: እኩለ ሌሊት ላይ አንድ ሰው “ሙሽራው መጣ! ውጡና ተቀበሉት!” ብሎ ጮኸ።

decisions.choice: there was a cry: told vividly with a perfect tense
decisions.reason: The tense makes the moment vivid; it describes one shout at midnight.

decisions.choice: look (L); "is here" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: him, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The bridegroom is a figure in a parable, so his pronouns take no span, as in 9:15 and John 3:29, though the story points to the Son of Man's coming.

decisions.choice: "chàng" for the bridegroom, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The bridegroom is a figure in the parable, so his pronoun takes no setting, as the English decision says; "chàng" is the natural word for a bridegroom in a story.

decisions.choice: "보라" (L); "왔다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Matthew's "look" as "보라"; Balanced and Readable carry it in "신랑이 왔다!", as the English does.

source.text: τότε ἠγέρθησαν πᾶσαι αἱ παρθένοι ἐκεῖναι καὶ ἐκόσμησαν τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Then arose all the virgins those and trimmed the lamps of them.

en.L: Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps.
en.B: Then all the young women woke up and got their lamps ready.
en.R: Then all the young women woke up and got their lamps ready to burn brightly.

es.L: Entonces se levantaron todas aquellas vírgenes y pusieron en orden sus lámparas.
es.B: Entonces todas las muchachas se despertaron y prepararon sus lámparas.
es.R: Entonces todas las muchachas se despertaron y prepararon sus lámparas para que alumbraran bien.

fr.L: Alors toutes ces vierges se sont levées et ont apprêté leurs lampes.
fr.B: Alors toutes les jeunes filles se sont réveillées et ont préparé leurs lampes.
fr.R: Alors toutes les jeunes filles se sont réveillées et elles ont préparé leurs lampes pour qu’elles brillent bien.

sw.L: Kisha mabikira wale wote waliamka, wakaziweka sawa taa zao.
sw.B: Kisha wasichana wote waliamka, wakaziandaa taa zao.
sw.R: Kisha wasichana wote waliamka, wakaziandaa taa zao ziwake vizuri.

vi.L: Bấy giờ tất cả các trinh nữ ấy thức dậy và sửa soạn đèn mình.
vi.B: Bấy giờ cả mười cô thức dậy và chuẩn bị đèn của mình.
vi.R: Bấy giờ tất cả các cô thức dậy và chuẩn bị đèn để đèn cháy sáng.

ko.L: 그때에 그 처녀들이 모두 일어나 자기 등불을 손질하였다.
ko.B: 그러자 처녀들이 모두 일어나 등불을 준비하였다.
ko.R: 그러자 여자들이 모두 일어나서, 등불이 환하게 타도록 준비하였다.

pt.L: Então todas aquelas virgens se levantaram e prepararam as suas lâmpadas.
pt.B: Então todas as moças acordaram e prepararam as suas lamparinas.
pt.R: Então todas as moças acordaram e prepararam as lamparinas para que dessem uma boa luz.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ እነዚያ ደናግል ሁሉ ተነሡ፤ መብራቶቻቸውንም አዘጋጁ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ልጃገረዶቹ ሁሉ ነቅተው መብራቶቻቸውን አዘጋጁ።
am.R: ከዚያም ልጃገረዶቹ ሁሉ ነቁ። መብራቶቻቸው በደንብ እንዲያበሩ አዘጋጇቸው።

decisions.choice: trimmed: put in order, by trimming the wick or adding oil
decisions.reason: The verb means to put in order. A lamp or torch was made to burn well again before the procession.

decisions.choice: got their lamps ready
decisions.reason: "Trimmed" is a technical word few readers know. Balanced and Readable say what the women did.

source.text: αἱ δὲ μωραὶ ταῖς φρονίμοις εἶπαν· Δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ ἐλαίου ὑμῶν, ὅτι αἱ λαμπάδες ἡμῶν σβέννυνται.

records.literal_gloss: The and foolish to the wise said: Give us of the oil of you, for the lamps of us are going out.

en.L: And the foolish said to the wise, 'Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.'
en.B: The foolish ones said to the wise, 'Share some of your oil with us; our lamps are going out.'
en.R: The foolish ones said to the wise ones, 'Please give us some of your oil. Our lamps are about to go out.'

es.L: Y las necias dijeron a las prudentes: “{{plural_you:Dennos|Dadnos}} de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} aceite, porque nuestras lámparas se apagan”.
es.B: Las necias dijeron a las prudentes: “{{plural_you:Compartan|Compartid}} con nosotras un poco de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} aceite; nuestras lámparas se están apagando”.
es.R: Las muchachas tontas dijeron a las sabias: “Por favor, {{plural_you:dennos|dadnos}} un poco de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} aceite. Nuestras lámparas están a punto de apagarse”.

fr.L: Et les insensées ont dit aux avisées : “Donnez-nous de votre huile, car nos lampes s’éteignent.”
fr.B: Les insensées ont dit aux sages : “Partagez avec nous un peu de votre huile : nos lampes s’éteignent.”
fr.R: Les jeunes filles étourdies ont dit aux sages : “S’il vous plaît, donnez-nous un peu de votre huile. Nos lampes vont s’éteindre.”

sw.L: Na wale wajinga wakawaambia wale wenye busara, 'Tupeni sehemu ya mafuta yenu, kwa sababu taa zetu zinazimika.'
sw.B: Wale wajinga wakawaambia wale wenye busara, 'Tugawieni mafuta yenu kidogo; taa zetu zinaanza kuzimika.'
sw.R: Wale wasichana wajinga wakawaambia wale wenye akili, 'Tafadhali tupeni mafuta yenu kidogo. Taa zetu karibu zizime.'

vi.L: Các cô dại dột nói với các cô khôn ngoan: 'Hãy cho chúng tôi một ít dầu của các chị, vì đèn của chúng tôi sắp tắt.'
vi.B: Các cô dại dột nói với các cô khôn ngoan: 'Chia cho chúng tôi một ít dầu với, đèn của chúng tôi sắp tắt rồi.'
vi.R: Các cô dại dột nói với các cô khôn ngoan: 'Làm ơn cho chúng tôi một ít dầu. Đèn của chúng tôi sắp tắt rồi.'

ko.L: 그런데 어리석은 처녀들이 슬기로운 처녀들에게 말했다. '너희 기름을 우리에게 좀 다오. 우리 등불이 꺼져 가고 있다.'
ko.B: 어리석은 처녀들이 슬기로운 처녀들에게 말했다. '우리에게 기름을 좀 나누어 다오. 우리 등불이 꺼져 간다.'
ko.R: 어리석은 여자들이 슬기로운 여자들에게 말했다. '제발 기름을 좀 나누어 다오. 우리 등불이 곧 꺼질 것 같다.'

pt.L: E as tolas disseram às prudentes: 'Deem-nos do azeite de vocês, porque as nossas lâmpadas estão se apagando.'
pt.B: As tolas disseram às prudentes: 'Repartam um pouco do seu azeite conosco; as nossas lamparinas estão se apagando.'
pt.R: As moças tolas disseram às sábias: 'Por favor, deem um pouco do azeite de vocês para nós. As nossas lamparinas estão quase apagando.'

am.L: ሞኞቹም ብልሆቹን፦ “ከዘይታችሁ ስጡን፤ መብራቶቻችን እየጠፉ ነውና።” አሏቸው።
am.B: ሞኞቹም ብልሆቹን፦ “ከዘይታችሁ አካፍሉን፤ መብራቶቻችን እየጠፉ ነው።” አሏቸው።
am.R: ሞኞቹ ብልሆቹን፦ “እባካችሁ ከዘይታችሁ ስጡን። መብራቶቻችን ሊጠፉ ነው።” አሏቸው።

decisions.choice: are going out: in the process of going out
decisions.reason: The present tense shows the flames dying, not already dead.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans in the young women's words (dennos|dadnos, su|vuestro)
decisions.reason: Every plural "you" in this file is the ustedes / vosotros setting, whether the young women speak to each other, the bridegroom speaks to them (25:12: las|os) or Jesus speaks to his disciples (25:13). Where the form shows gender, it is feminine (ustedes mismas|vosotras mismas).

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" and "các chị" between the young women
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must choose words for "we" and "you"; young women of one age asking a favour of the others speak politely, as "chúng tôi" to "các chị".

decisions.choice: The young women speak to one another in 해라체
decisions.reason: Equals among themselves use the plain style (style guide, section 4), here and in 25:9.

source.text: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι· Μήποτε οὐ μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν· πορεύεσθε μᾶλλον πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Answered then the wise saying: Lest not not it suffice for us and you; go rather to those selling and buy for yourselves.

en.L: But the wise answered, saying, '[No,] lest there not be enough for us and for you; go instead to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.'
en.B: But the wise ones replied, 'We cannot; there would surely not be enough for both you and us. You had better go to the oil sellers and buy your own.'
en.R: The wise ones answered, 'No. If we give you some, there will not be enough for any of us. Go to the people who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.'

es.L: Pero respondieron las prudentes, diciendo: “[No,] no sea que no alcance para nosotras y para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}; {{plural_you:vayan|id}} más bien a los que venden y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} para {{plural_you:ustedes mismas|vosotras mismas}}”.
es.B: Pero las prudentes respondieron: “No podemos; seguro que no alcanzaría para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}} y para nosotras. Mejor {{plural_you:vayan|id}} a los que venden aceite y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} el {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}”.
es.R: Las sabias contestaron: “No. Si {{plural_you:les|os}} damos, no habrá suficiente para ninguna. {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a los que venden aceite y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotras}}”.

fr.L: Mais les avisées ont répondu, disant : “[Non,] de peur qu’il n’y en ait pas assez pour nous et pour vous ; allez plutôt chez ceux qui vendent et achetez pour vous-mêmes.”
fr.B: Mais les sages ont répondu : “Nous ne pouvons pas : il n’y en aurait sûrement pas assez pour nous et pour vous. Allez plutôt chez les marchands d’huile, et achetez-en pour vous.”
fr.R: Les jeunes filles sages ont répondu : “Non. Si nous vous en donnons, il n’y en aura assez pour personne. Allez chez les gens qui vendent de l’huile, et achetez-en pour vous.”

sw.L: Lakini wale wenye busara wakajibu, wakisema, '[Hapana,] isije ikawa hayatatutosha sisi na ninyi; badala yake nendeni kwa wale wanaouza, mjinunulie wenyewe.'
sw.B: Lakini wale wenye busara wakajibu, 'Hatuwezi; hakika hayatatutosha sisi na ninyi. Ni heri mwende kwa wauzaji wa mafuta mjinunulie yenu wenyewe.'
sw.R: Wale wenye akili wakajibu, 'Hapana. Tukiwapa, mafuta hayatatosha kwa yeyote kati yetu. Nendeni kwa watu wanaouza mafuta, mjinunulie wenyewe.'

vi.L: Nhưng các cô khôn ngoan trả lời rằng: '[Không được,] e rằng không đủ cho chúng tôi và các chị; tốt hơn các chị hãy đi đến những người bán mà mua lấy cho mình.'
vi.B: Nhưng các cô khôn ngoan đáp: 'Không được đâu, e rằng không đủ cho cả chúng tôi lẫn các chị. Tốt hơn các chị hãy đến chỗ người bán dầu mà mua lấy.'
vi.R: Các cô khôn ngoan trả lời: 'Không được. Nếu chia cho các chị, sẽ không đủ cho ai cả. Các chị hãy đi đến những người bán dầu mà mua cho mình.'

ko.L: 그러나 슬기로운 처녀들이 대답하여 말했다. '[안 된다.] 우리와 너희가 쓰기에 모자랄까 [걱정된다]. 차라리 파는 사람들에게 가서 너희가 쓸 것을 사라.'
ko.B: 그러나 슬기로운 처녀들이 대답했다. '그럴 수 없다. 우리와 너희가 함께 쓰기에는 분명히 모자랄 것이다. 차라리 기름 파는 사람들에게 가서 너희 것을 사는 게 낫겠다.'
ko.R: 슬기로운 여자들이 대답했다. '안 된다. 너희에게 나누어 주면 우리 모두에게 모자랄 것이다. 기름 파는 사람들에게 가서 너희가 쓸 것을 사라.'

pt.L: Mas as prudentes responderam, dizendo: '[Não,] para que não falte para nós e para vocês; vão antes aos que vendem e comprem para vocês.'
pt.B: Mas as prudentes responderam: 'Não podemos; com certeza não haveria o bastante para nós e para vocês. É melhor vocês irem aos vendedores e comprarem o seu.'
pt.R: As moças sábias responderam: 'Não. Se dermos um pouco a vocês, não vai dar para nenhuma de nós. Vão às pessoas que vendem azeite e comprem para vocês.'

am.L: ብልሆቹ ግን፦ “[አይሆንም፤] ለእኛና ለእናንተ እንዳይበቃ፤ ይልቅስ ወደሚሸጡት ሄዳችሁ ለራሳችሁ ግዙ።” ብለው መለሱ።

decisions.choice: lest there not be enough: a refusal with a strong reason
decisions.reason: The opening word expresses a fear, and the double negative makes it strong. The answer is no, because sharing would leave all ten without light.

decisions.choice: those who sell: oil sellers in the town
decisions.reason: The advice is practical, but at midnight it means being away when the bridegroom comes.

decisions.choice: [No,] (L); We cannot (B); No (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek implies the refusal before giving the reason; each level states it.

decisions.choice: [안 된다.] ... [걱정된다] (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek clause "lest there not be enough" hangs on an unspoken refusal (meaning decision); Korean needs both the refusal and a verb for "lest", which Literal brackets.

en.L: And while they were going away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

es.L: Y mientras se alejaban para comprar, llegó el novio, y las [que estaban] listas entraron con él al banquete de bodas, y fue cerrada la puerta.
es.B: Mientras ellas estaban fuera comprándolo, llegó el novio. Las que estaban listas entraron con él a la fiesta de bodas, y se cerró la puerta.

vi.R: Vậy các cô ấy đi mua dầu. Trong lúc họ đi vắng, chàng rể đến. Những cô đã sẵn sàng cùng chàng vào dự tiệc cưới. Rồi có người đóng cửa lại.

ko.L: 그런데 그들이 사러 간 사이에 신랑이 왔다. 그리고 준비된 처녀들은 신랑과 함께 혼인 잔치에 들어갔고, 문은 닫혔다.

pt.B: Enquanto elas foram comprar, o noivo chegou. As que estavam prontas entraram com ele para a festa de casamento, e a porta foi fechada.

ko.R: 나중에 다른 여자들이 돌아와서 외쳤다. '주님, 주님, 문을 열고 저희를 들여보내 주십시오!'

pt.B: Mais tarde chegaram também as outras moças. 'Senhor, senhor', elas gritaram, 'abra a porta para nós!'
pt.R: Mais tarde, as outras moças voltaram. Elas chamaram: 'Senhor, senhor, abra a porta e deixe a gente entrar!'

decisions.choice: Lord, lord: an echo of 7:21-22
decisions.reason: The double address is what a guest would say to the master of the feast, but it repeats the words of those who are turned away in 7:21-23. The story points to the Lord's coming.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: Lord, lord
decisions.reason: Keeping "Lord" at every level lets the reader hear the echo of 7:21-22. The second word is lowercase because the speaker is a figure in a parable.

decisions.choice: Seigneur, seigneur; the women say "tu" to him
decisions.reason: As the English: keeping "Seigneur" at every level lets the reader hear the echo of 7:21-22 (m1); the second word is lowercase because the speaker is a figure in a parable. French "tu" to one person, as the style guide asks.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (wanakuja); past at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the English: Matthew tells this step in the present. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable tell the story in the narrative past, with -li- for the first verb and -ka- for those that follow.

decisions.choice: "Thưa chủ, thưa chủ"
decisions.reason: In the story the women speak to the bridegroom as master of the feast, so Vietnamese uses "chủ" without a capital; the echo of 7:21-22 (meaning decision) is heard in the doubled address, though Vietnamese must choose between "chủ" and "Chúa" where the Greek has one word. Literal keeps the present "đến" without "đã".

decisions.choice: "주님, 주님" at every level, in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The double address echoes 7:21-22 (meaning decision), where the Korean Matthew has "주님, 주님"; the same words keep the echo, although elsewhere in parables a master is "주인".

decisions.choice: Present "와서 말한다" (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew's present tense of narration at Literal.

decisions.choice: "우리" (L, B); "저희" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the humble "저희" of people pleading with a superior; Literal and Balanced keep the plain "우리" of the Greek and the earlier dialogue.

decisions.choice: abra (the form that goes with "o senhor")
decisions.reason: The women call to the bridegroom as "Senhor", speaking up to the master of the feast, so the command takes the form that goes with "o senhor" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); "tu" is kept for words addressed to God or Jesus.

decisions.choice: deixe a gente entrar
decisions.reason: Readable puts a cry in the words people would shout; "a gente" is the everyday Brazilian "us" and is accepted in plain written Portuguese, where "deixe-nos" sounds formal.

decisions.choice: "ጌታ ሆይ" with the familiar "you" ("ክፈትልን", "ከፍተህ")
decisions.reason: The women call on the bridegroom as "Lord", the address the parable shares with 7:21-22, so it takes the same form Amharic uses to Jesus: "ጌታ ሆይ" and the familiar singular, as docs/amharic-style.md section 4 sets for the whole book. A reviewer may prefer the respectful form for a human bridegroom.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς.

en.R: But he answered, 'I tell you the truth, I do not know you.'

es.L: Pero él, respondiendo, dijo: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: no {{plural_you:las|os}} conozco”.
es.B: Pero él les respondió: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que no {{plural_you:las|os}} conozco”.
es.R: Pero él contestó: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: no {{plural_you:las|os}} conozco”.

fr.R: Mais il a répondu : “Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : je ne vous connais pas.”

sw.L: Lakini yeye akajibu, akasema, 'Kweli nawaambia, siwajui ninyi.'
sw.R: Lakini yeye akajibu, 'Nawaambia ukweli: siwajui ninyi.'

vi.B: Nhưng chàng đáp: 'Thật vậy, ta nói với các cô, ta không biết các cô là ai.'
vi.R: Nhưng chàng trả lời: 'Ta nói thật với các cô, ta không biết các cô.'

ko.L: 그러나 그가 대답하여 말했다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 나는 너희를 알지 못한다.'
ko.B: 그러나 신랑이 대답했다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 나는 너희를 모른다.'
ko.R: 그러나 신랑은 대답했다. '내가 분명히 말한다. 나는 너희를 모른다.'

pt.L: Mas ele, respondendo, disse: 'Em verdade eu lhes digo: não as conheço.'
pt.B: Mas ele respondeu: 'Em verdade eu lhes digo: não conheço vocês.'
pt.R: Mas ele respondeu: 'Eu garanto a vocês: eu não conheço vocês.'

am.L: እርሱ ግን መልሶ፦ “እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ አላውቃችሁም።” አለ።
am.B: እርሱ ግን፦ “እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ አላውቃችሁም።” ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: እርሱ ግን፦ “እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፣ አላውቃችሁም።” ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

decisions.choice: I do not know you: I do not own you as mine
alternatives: I do not recognize your faces
decisions.reason: As in 7:23, "I never knew you", the words disown them. They are not counted among the bridegroom's guests.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:18, the solemn opening keeps the settled wording.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used through Matthew. Here it is the bridegroom's word in the parable.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used through Matthew. Here it is the bridegroom's word in the parable.

decisions.choice: "ta" lowercase, with no deity_pronoun span, in the bridegroom's words
decisions.reason: The bridegroom is a figure in the parable, as a master in a parable takes no span (18:32); his solemn "Truly" keeps the Gospels' form, addressed to "các cô".

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R) in the bridegroom's mouth
decisions.reason: The bridegroom uses Jesus' own formula; Korean keeps the settled words so the echo is heard. He speaks in 해라체, as a master to those he refuses.

decisions.choice: keep awake: stay alert and ready
decisions.reason: All ten slept (25:5), so the command is not about sleep. It means to live ready for the Lord's coming, as in 24:42.

decisions.choice: the day nor the hour, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "in which the Son of Man is coming", making plain what 24:44 already says. The earliest manuscripts end with "the hour". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: stay awake and be ready
decisions.reason: Readable adds "be ready", following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "깨어 있어라" (L, B, R); "잠들지 말고" and "준비하고 있어라" added (R)
decisions.reason: As in 24:42 and the Korean Mark 13:33-37; Readable adds "be ready", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Vigiem (L); Fiquem atentos (B)
decisions.reason: All ten women slept (meaning decision), so Balanced says "atentos", alert, rather than "acordados", which is only about sleep; Literal keeps "vigiar", which in Portuguese means both.

decisions.choice: "ንቁ" (be awake, be alert)
decisions.reason: "ንቁ" says both staying awake and being alert, as the Greek does, in an everyday word; "ትጉ" is the older church word and "ተጠንቀቁ" means "be careful". The same word is used for this verb in Gethsemane (26:38-41).
